## Libraries

```{r cars}
library(raster)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(mignette)
```

## Data
You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r}
band<-read_delim("input/Banding/BBL2025_Req_3027_enc_3600_20260204_060002.csv",delim=",") %>% dplyr::select(-c(other_bands,species_name,species_id,bird_status,extra_info_code,age_code,band_status_code,how_obtained_code,who_obtained_code,reporting_method,present_condition,min_age_at_enc,record_id,record_source,coordinates_precision_code,band_type_code,permit,sex_code))
dim(band)
#7454 rows ()
```
# Split into breeding and wintering
```{r}
band_winter<-band %>% filter(event_month %in% c("11","12","1","2")) %>% filter(event_type=="B")
band_breed<-band %>% filter(event_month %in% c("5","6","7")) %>% filter(event_type=="B")

encounter_winter<-band %>% filter(event_month %in% c("11","12","1","2")) %>% filter(event_type=="E") %>%
  rename(winter_event_type=event_type,winter_event_date=event_date,winter_iso_country=iso_country,winter_iso_sub=iso_subdivision,winter_lat=lat_dd,winter_long=lon_dd) %>%
  dplyr::select(band,winter_event_type,winter_event_date,winter_iso_country,winter_iso_sub,winter_lat,winter_long)

encounter_breed<-band %>% filter(event_month %in% c("5","6","7")) %>% filter(event_type=="E") %>%
  rename(breed_event_type=event_type,breed_event_date=event_date,breed_iso_country=iso_country,breed_iso_sub=iso_subdivision,breeding_lat=lat_dd,breeding_long=lon_dd) %>%
  dplyr::select(band,breed_event_type,breed_event_date,breed_iso_country,breed_iso_sub,breeding_lat,breeding_long)
```

# Make the combination by changing column names to match across seasons, and removing columns that do not matter for this analysis.

```{r}
bw_eb<-band_winter %>% left_join(encounter_breed) %>% filter(breed_event_type!="NA") %>%
  filter(!is.na(breeding_lat)) %>% rename(winter_event_type=event_type,winter_event_date=event_date,winter_event_day=event_day,winter_event_month=event_month,winter_event_year=event_year,winter_iso_country=iso_country,winter_iso_sub=iso_subdivision,winter_lat=lat_dd,winter_long=lon_dd) 

```

```{r}
bw_eb_coordW<- st_as_sf(bw_eb, coords = c("winter_long", "winter_lat"), 
                   crs = 4326)

bw_eb_coordB<- st_as_sf(bw_eb, coords = c("breeding_long", "breeding_lat"), 
                   crs = 4326)

```

```{r}
bb_ew <- band_breed %>% left_join(encounter_winter) %>%
  filter(winter_event_type!="NA") %>%
  rename(breed_event_type=event_type,breed_event_date=event_date,breed_event_day=event_day,breed_event_month=event_month,breed_event_year=event_year,breed_iso_country=iso_country,breed_iso_sub=iso_subdivision,breeding_lat=lat_dd,breeding_long=lon_dd) 
```

```{r}
bb_ew_coordW<- st_as_sf(bb_ew, coords = c("winter_long", "winter_lat"), 
                   crs = 4326)

bb_ew_coordB<- st_as_sf(bb_ew, coords = c("breeding_long", "breeding_lat"), 
                   crs = 4326)

```
# Place on map and filter on whether the winter birds intersect with nonbreeding region
```{r}
ecoregion<-read_sf("AMKE_shapefiles_rasters/winter_ecoregion/AMKE.winterEcoregions.simple.sf.WGS84.noWater.Ebird.shp")

# This function performs a left spatial join, keeping all points and adding polygon attributes to those that intersect. Points outside the polygon are called as NA and require filtering after, so instead we use st_intersection

#if you use st_intersection, there are no NA's
##Of 193, 171 remain from all, 43 if just the genetic ecoregions, but we are using all possible ecoregions
out_bw_eb_intsctW <- st_intersection(bw_eb_coordW, ecoregion) %>% 
  mutate(winter_long = st_coordinates(.)[,1],
         winter_lat = st_coordinates(.)[,2]) %>%
  dplyr::select(-layer) %>% st_drop_geometry()

#of 801, 758 intersect with ecoregions, 200 of just the genetic ecoregions
out_bb_ew_intsctW <- st_intersection(bb_ew_coordW, ecoregion) %>% 
  mutate(winter_long = st_coordinates(.)[,1],
         winter_lat = st_coordinates(.)[,2]) %>%
  dplyr::select(-layer) %>% st_drop_geometry()

```

# Now check which breeding birds fall within known distinct breeding units
```{r}
AK <- st_read("AMKE_shapefiles_rasters/genoscape_polygon/AMKE_crop.genoscape_brick_4.45no_ovlp.WGS84.shp") 
West <- st_read("AMKE_shapefiles_rasters/genoscape_polygon/AMKE_crop.genoscape_brick_2.45no_ovlp.WGS84.shp") 
TX <- st_read("AMKE_shapefiles_rasters/genoscape_polygon/AMKE_crop.genoscape_brick_5.45no_ovlp.WGS84.shp") 
East <- st_read("AMKE_shapefiles_rasters/genoscape_polygon/AMKE_crop.genoscape_brick_1.45no_ovlp.WGS84.shp") 
FL <- st_read("AMKE_shapefiles_rasters/genoscape_polygon/AMKE_crop.genoscape_brick_3.45no_ovlp.WGS84.shp") 

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = East,alpha = 0.75, aes(fill = "red")) +
  geom_sf(data = West,alpha = 0.75, aes(fill = "blue")) +
  geom_sf(data = FL,alpha = 0.75, aes(fill = "cyan")) +
  geom_sf(data = AK,alpha = 0.75, aes(fill = "yellow")) +
  geom_sf(data = TX,alpha = 0.75, aes(fill = "orange")) +
  #scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colors) +
  theme_bw()

genoscape <- rbind(AK,
                   West,
                   East,
                   FL,
                   TX)
genoscape$Cluster <- c("AK", "West", "East", "FL","TX")


#of 801 birds, 776 fall within genoscape
out_bb_ew_intsctB <- st_intersection(bb_ew_coordB, genoscape) %>% 
  mutate(breeding_long = st_coordinates(.)[,1],
         breeding_lat = st_coordinates(.)[,2]) %>%
  dplyr::select(-layer)%>% st_drop_geometry()
out_bb_ew_intsctB %>% distinct(Cluster) #West,East,FL,TX

#of 193 birds, 162 fall within genoscape
out_bw_eb_intsctB <- st_intersection(bw_eb_coordW, genoscape) %>% 
  mutate(breeding_long = st_coordinates(.)[,1],
         breeding_lat = st_coordinates(.)[,2]) %>%
  dplyr::select(-layer) %>% st_drop_geometry()

dim(out_bw_eb_intsctW) #intersect on winter nodes 43, 171 for all data
dim(out_bw_eb_intsctB) #intersect on genoscape nodes, 162=same

dim(out_bb_ew_intsctW) #intersect on winter nodes 200, 758 with all data
dim(out_bb_ew_intsctB) #intersect on genoscape nodes, 776=same for all data
```

## Combine again for all the ones the intersect with ecoregions and genoscape
```{r}
#my a1 and b1 values are different

a1<-data.frame(out_bw_eb_intsctW) %>% full_join(data.frame(out_bw_eb_intsctB)) %>% filter(!is.na(Cluster)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Region)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c(winter_event_day,winter_event_month,winter_event_year)) 


b1<-data.frame(out_bb_ew_intsctW) %>% full_join(data.frame(out_bb_ew_intsctB)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Cluster)) %>% filter(!is.na(Region)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c(breed_event_day,breed_event_month,breed_event_year)) 

#put b1 column names in same order as a1 and confirm they have the same column names
common_cols <- intersect(colnames(a1), colnames(b1))
common_cols
setdiff(colnames(a1), colnames(b1))

##put b1 column in same order as a1
b1 <- b1[, colnames(a1)]

#combine using row bind function (rbind)
bbl_eco_genetic <- rbind(a1,b1)
#write.csv(bbl_eco_genetic, 'input/MigConn/AMKEbandingrecoverymatrix.csv' )
bbl_eco_genetic<-read_csv("input/MigConn/AMKEbandingrecoverymatrix_filt.csv")
recmatrix<-bbl_eco_genetic %>%
  dplyr::select(Cluster, Region) %>%
  filter(!Cluster == '<NA>',
         !Region == '<NA>',
         Cluster %in% c("AK", "West", "TX", "East","FL")) %>%
  group_by(Cluster, Region) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Region, values_from = n) %>%
  ungroup() 

Breeding.name <- recmatrix$Cluster

recmatrix <-
  recmatrix %>%
  dplyr::select(-Cluster) %>%
  as.matrix()

recmatrix[is.na(recmatrix)] = 0
rownames(recmatrix) <- Breeding.name
cat('recmatrix:\n'); print(recmatrix)


# Need to reverse order again to get west to east...
recmatrix <- recmatrix[nrow(recmatrix):1, ncol(recmatrix):1]

#write.csv(recmatrix,  'input/MigConn/AMKE815_recovery_matrix_all_data_geneco.csv')
sub_recoveries <- sum(recmatrix)
sub_recoveries

recmatrix<-read.csv("input/MigConn/AMKE815_recovery_matrix_all_data_geneco.csv",row.names = 1,stringsAsFactors=T)

```
## Plot the kept BBL data

```{r}

library(sf)
library(ggspatial)
library(ggplot2)
library(raster)
library(dplyr)
library(tess3r)
library(genoscapeRtools)
##adding ecoregion labels
ecoregion <- st_read("AMKE_shapefiles_rasters/winter_ecoregion/AMKE.winterEcoregions.simple.sf.WGS84.noWater.Ebird.shp") %>%
  mutate(node = case_when(
    Region == "North American Deserts" ~ "NAD",
    Region == "Great Plains" ~ "GP",
    Region == "Eastern Temperate Forests" ~ "ETF",
    Region == "Northwestern Forested Mountains" ~ "NWFM",
    Region == "Marine West Coast Forests" ~ "MWCF",
    Region == "Highland/Interior Mexico" ~ "HIM",
    Region == "Highland Central America" ~ "HCA",
    Region == "Northwest Mexico" ~ "NWM",
    Region == "Atlantic Lowland Mexico" ~ "ALM",
    Region == "California" ~ "CAL",
    Region == "Southcentral US" ~ "SCUS",
    Region == "Southeastern US" ~ "SEUS",
    Region == "Southwest Mexico" ~ "SWM",
    Region == "Northern Andes" ~ "NAndes",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_   
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(node))
centroids <- cbind(
  ecoregion,
  st_coordinates(st_centroid(ecoregion))
)

# ---- Load nice background ----
# This raster is easily downloaded from ne_rasters
hypso_bg <- raster::stack("~/Dropbox/BGP/genoscape_maps/shapefiles/ne_rasters/HYP_HR_SR_OB_DR/HYP_HR_SR_OB_DR.tif")

# ---- Read and crop the breeding range shapefile ----
# This shapefile is easily downloaded from eBird ()
breeding <- st_read("AMKE_shapefiles_rasters/eBird_range/AMKE.range_smooth.sf.WGS84.Ebird.shp") %>%
  filter(season == "breeding")

breeding_crop <- st_crop(breeding, c(xmin=-152.9703, xmax=-37.20669, ymin=14, ymax=68.98193))

# ---- Read and prepare the genoscape raster ----
genoscape_brick1 <- stack("AMKE_shapefiles_rasters/AMKE_crop.genoscape_brick.tif")
crs(genoscape_brick1) <- "EPSG:4326"
summary(genoscape_brick1)
names(genoscape_brick1) <- c("West", "TX", "East", "FL", "AK")
cluster_colors <-  c(
  AK= "cyan",#AK, cyan 
  West = "#ffff33", #west yellow 
  TX = "#ff7f00", #TX, orange 
  East = "#377eb8", #East, blue
  FL = "#984ea3" #FL, purple 
  ) 


# ---- Convert raster to RGBA using genoscapeRtools ----
genoscape_rgba <- genoscapeRtools::qprob_rando_raster(
  TRB = genoscape_brick1,
  cols = cluster_colors, 
  alpha_scale = 2, 
  abs_thresh = 0.0, 
  alpha_exp = 1.8, 
  alpha_chop_max = 230,
  scale_min_to = 0
)

crs(genoscape_rgba) <- "+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs +ellps=WGS84 +towgs84=0,0,0"

# ---- Define North America crop (roughly matches breeding_crop) ----
na_xlim <- c(-152.97, -65)
na_ylim <- c(18, 68.98)
# ---- Adjust line colors for visibility ----
line_colors <- c(
  AK= "cyan",
  West = "goldenrod",  # darker yellow for West cluster
  TX = "#ff7f00",
  East = "#377eb8",
  FL = "#984ea3" 
)


# ---- Plot the final map ----
main_map <- ggplot() +
   ggspatial::layer_spatial(hypso_bg_cropped, alpha=.8) +
  # Raster background (slightly transparent)
  ggspatial::layer_spatial(genoscape_rgba, alpha = 0.7) +
  
  # Breeding range polygon
  geom_sf(data = breeding_crop, fill = NA, color = "grey50") +
  
  # Optional: ecoregion outlines
geom_sf(
  data = ecoregion,
  fill = NA,
  color = "gray50",
  size = 0.25
) +
  
  # Points (smaller squares)
  geom_point(
    data = bbl_eco_genetic,
    aes(x = winter_long, y = winter_lat, fill = Cluster),
    shape = 22,
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  
  # Lines colored by cluster (with darker yellow for West)
  geom_segment(
    data = bbl_eco_genetic,
    aes(x = winter_long, y = winter_lat, xend = breeding_long, yend = breeding_lat, color = Cluster),
    linewidth = 0.3,
    alpha = 0.9,
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
    geom_text(
  data = centroids,
  aes(x = X, y = Y, label = node),
  size = 3
) +
  
  # Color scales
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = line_colors) +
  
  # Crop to North America
  coord_sf(xlim = na_xlim, ylim = na_ylim) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )

main_map
```

#Filter to zoom in on texas and florida residents
```{r}
tx_xlim <- c(-107, -93)   # approx. west to east Texas
tx_ylim <- c(25, 37) 

fl_xlim <- c(-87.7, -79.7)  # from panhandle to east coast
fl_ylim <- c(24.5, 31.0) 

tx_data <- bbl_eco_genetic %>%
  filter(Cluster == "TX")

fl_data <- bbl_eco_genetic %>%
  filter(Cluster == "FL")

tx_map <- ggplot() +
  ggspatial::layer_spatial(hypso_bg, alpha = .8) +
  ggspatial::layer_spatial(genoscape_rgba, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_sf(data = breeding_crop, fill = NA, color = "grey50") +
  geom_sf(data = ecoregion, fill = NA, color = "grey70", alpha = 0.5) +

  # ONLY TX points
  geom_point(
    data = tx_data,
    aes(x = winter_long, y = winter_lat, fill = Cluster),
    shape = 22,
    size = 1.5
  ) +

  # ONLY TX lines
  geom_segment(
    data = tx_data,
    aes(x = winter_long, y = winter_lat,
        xend = breeding_long, yend = breeding_lat,
        color = Cluster),
    linewidth = 0.3,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = line_colors) +

  coord_sf(xlim = tx_xlim, ylim = tx_ylim, expand = FALSE) +

  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank()
  )

tx_map
```

#combine into banding genoscape with resident popouts
```{r}
library(cowplot)

final_map <- ggdraw() +
  draw_plot(main_map) +
  draw_plot(tx_map, x = 0.05, y = 0.06, width = 0.3, height = 0.3) +
draw_plot(fl_map, x = 0.6, y = 0.7, width = 0.3, height = 0.3) 

final_map
ggsave(
  filename = "output/Banding_filtered/map_with_popouts_ALLECOREGIONS.pdf",  # name & format
  plot = final_map,                   # the plot object
  width = 12,                         # width in inches
  height = 6.96,                         # height in inches
  units = "in",                        # units for width/height
  dpi = 300                            
)

```
